title: Fix avatar distortion for non-square images
description:
Non-square avatars on /team/members get distorted instead of being cropped to square.

**Root cause:** The AvatarImage component (app/ui/shadcn/avatar.tsx:26) uses `aspect-square h-full w-full` but lacks `object-cover`. This causes non-square images to stretch instead of crop.

**Fix:** Add `object-cover` to the AvatarImage className to crop and center non-square images properly.

comments.author: Ralph
comments.text: Fixed by adding object-cover to AvatarImage className in app/ui/shadcn/avatar.tsx. This ensures non-square images are cropped and centered instead of being stretched to fit the square aspect ratio. Committed and pushed: 2a4a02f
